movies.overview: When larcenous real estate clerk Marion Crane goes on the lam with a wad of cash and hopes of starting a new life, she ends up at the notorious Bates Motel, where manager Norman Bates cares for his housebound mother.
movies.title: Psycho
movies.tagline: A new and altogether different screen excitement!

movies.overview: Fifteen years after murdering his sister on Halloween Night 1963, Michael Myers escapes from a mental hospital and returns to the small town of Haddonfield, Illinois to kill again.
movies.title: Halloween
movies.tagline: The night he came home!

movies.overview: Teenagers in a small town are dropping like flies, apparently in the grip of mass hysteria causing their suicides. A cop's daughter, Nancy Thompson, traces the cause to child molester Fred Krueger, who was burned alive by angry parents many years before. Krueger has now come back in the dreams of his killers' children, claiming their lives as his revenge. Nancy and her boyfriend, Glen, must devise a plan to lure the monster out of the realm of nightmares and into the real world...
movies.title: A Nightmare on Elm Street
movies.tagline: If Nancy doesn't wake up screaming, she won't wake up at all.

movies.overview: Trapped on her family’s isolated farm, Pearl must tend to her ailing father under the bitter and overbearing watch of her devout mother. Lusting for a glamorous life like she’s seen in the movies, Pearl’s ambitions, temptations, and repressions collide.
movies.title: Pearl
movies.tagline: An X-traordinary origin story.

movies.overview: When the infamous "Sweet Sixteen Killer" returns 35 years after his first murder spree to claim another victim, 17-year-old Jamie accidentally travels back in time to 1987, determined to stop the killer before he can start.
movies.title: Totally Killer
movies.tagline: Murder is so 1987.

movies.original_title: Sweeney Todd: The Demon Barber of Fleet Street
movies.overview: The infamous story of Benjamin Barker, a.k.a Sweeney Todd, who sets up a barber shop down in London which is the basis for a sinister partnership with his fellow tenant, Mrs. Lovett. Based on the hit Broadway musical.
movies.title: Sweeney Todd: The Demon Barber of Fleet Street
movies.tagline: Never Forget. Never Forgive.

movies.overview: A year after the Miles County massacre, Art the Clown is resurrected by a sinister entity. Art returns home, where he must hunt down and destroy teenage Sienna and her younger brother Jonathan on Halloween. As the body count rises, the siblings fight to stay alive while uncovering the true nature of Art's evil intent.
movies.title: Terrifier 2
movies.tagline: Who's laughing now?

movies.overview: After a Black Friday riot ends in tragedy, a mysterious Thanksgiving-inspired killer terrorizes Plymouth, Massachusetts - the birthplace of the holiday. Picking off residents one by one, what begins as random revenge killings are soon revealed to be part of a larger, sinister holiday plan.
movies.title: Thanksgiving
movies.tagline: There will be no leftovers.

movies.overview: A Chicago artist's sanity starts to unravel, unleashing a terrifying wave of violence when he begins to explore the macabre history of the Candyman.
movies.title: Candyman
movies.tagline: Dare to say his name.

movies.overview: A mystical, ancient dagger causes a notorious serial killer to magically switch bodies with a 17-year-old girl.
movies.title: Freaky
movies.tagline: Basic switch. Killer new look.

movies.overview: Five friends head out to rural Texas to visit the grave of a grandfather. On the way, they stumble across what appears to be a deserted house, only to discover something sinister within. Something armed with a chainsaw.
movies.title: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre
movies.tagline: Who will survive and what will be left of them?

movies.overview: After witnessing a mysterious woman brutally slay a homemaker, prostitute Liz Blake finds herself trapped in a dangerous situation. While the police thinks she is the murderer, the real killer is intent on silencing her only witness.
movies.title: Dressed to Kill
movies.tagline: The latest fashion in murder.

movies.overview: Two years after the Woodsboro murders, Sidney Prescott acclimates to college life while someone donning the Ghostface costume begins a new string of killings.
movies.title: Scream 2
movies.tagline: Someone has taken their love of sequels one step too far.

movies.overview: A year after the murder of her mother, a teenage girl is terrorized by a masked killer who targets her and her friends by using scary movies as part of a deadly game.
movies.title: Scream
movies.tagline: Someone has taken their love of scary movies one step too far. Solving this mystery is going to be murder.

movies.overview: When the Davison family comes under attack during their wedding anniversary getaway, the gang of mysterious killers soon learns that one of their victims harbors a secret talent for fighting back.
movies.title: You're Next
movies.tagline: Did you remember to lock your door?

movies.overview: Fifteen years after murdering his sister on Halloween Night 1963, Michael Myers escapes from a mental hospital and returns to the small town of Haddonfield, Illinois to kill again.
movies.title: Halloween
movies.tagline: The night he came home!

movies.overview: The Candyman, a murderous soul with a hook for a hand, is accidentally summoned to reality by a skeptic grad student researching the monster's myth.
movies.title: Candyman
movies.tagline: We dare you to say his name five times.

movies.overview: A demonic force has chosen Freddy Krueger as its portal to the real world. Can Heather Langenkamp play the part of Nancy one last time and trap the evil trying to enter our world?
movies.title: New Nightmare
movies.tagline: This time the terror doesn't stop at the screen.

movies.overview: Following the latest Ghostface killings, the four survivors leave Woodsboro behind and start a fresh chapter.
movies.title: Scream VI
movies.tagline: New York. New rules.

movies.overview: Twenty-five years after a streak of brutal murders shocked the quiet town of Woodsboro, a new killer has donned the Ghostface mask and begins targeting a group of teenagers to resurrect secrets from the town’s deadly past.
movies.title: Scream
movies.tagline: It's always someone you know.

movies.overview: Dana, daughter of the only survivor of a massacre in 1993, is going on a weekend trip with her friends. After their car breaks down in the very same town where her mother once fought the Driller Killer, Dana and her friends must come face-to-face with the man who has haunted her mother’s life for the past 30 years.
movies.title: Slumber Party Massacre
movies.tagline: You know the drill!

movies.original_title: Il tuo vizio è una stanza chiusa e solo io ne ho la chiave
movies.overview: Oliviero is a drunk, burned-out writer who amuses himself by hosting orgies at his grand country manor and humiliating his wife Irina. When a number of women are murdered in grisly fashion, Oliviero becomes a prime suspect.
movies.title: Your Vice Is a Locked Room and Only I Have the Key
movies.tagline: Unlock the Secrets of Your Darkest Desires!

movies.overview: A talk show hostess takes a camera crew out to an abandoned factory to investigate a purported snuff film that was made there. As she gets closer to the truth, she and her friends are subjected to a brutal nightmare.
movies.title: Evil Dead Trap
movies.tagline: Pure terror!

movies.overview: Rejected by her lover, the only man left in Cheryl's life is the orphaned nephew she has raised as her own son. She'll stop at nothing to keep Billy with her. When her plans misfire, she is swept up into an insane frenzy that means death to anyone who comes between her and her obsession. But the investigating detective is convinced that Billy is the real killer - and determined to prove it. Madness and fanaticism work together to drag all concerned into a terrifying vortex of blood-letting that adds a nightmarish twist to the classic Oedipus story.
movies.title: Butcher, Baker, Nightmare Maker
movies.tagline: She was lonely. He was all she had. No one would take him from her…and live.

movies.overview: An English pianist living in Rome witnesses the brutal murder of his psychic neighbor. With the help of a tenacious young reporter, he tries to discover the killer using very unconventional methods. The two are soon drawn into a shocking web of dementia and violence.
movies.title: Deep Red
movies.tagline: When was the last time you were really scared?

movies.overview: A young opera singer is stalked by a deranged fan bent on killing the people associated with her to claim her for himself.
movies.title: Opera
movies.tagline: Obsession. Murder. Madness.

movies.overview: Seemingly mild-mannered Henry Morrison has just murdered his entire family. After adopting a new identity and skipping town, he begins building a new relationship with a widow and her teenage daughter. However, he soon begins struggling to hide his true identity and maintain a grip on reality.
movies.title: The Stepfather
movies.tagline: He wanted a perfect family in a perfect town. But they couldn't measure up...Neither could the others...

movies.overview: An elderly heiress is killed by her husband who wants control of her fortunes. What ensues is an all-out murder spree as relatives and friends attempt to reduce the inheritance playing field, complicated by some teenagers who decide to camp out in a dilapidated building on the estate.
movies.title: A Bay of Blood
movies.tagline: They came to play, they stayed to die.

movies.overview: Years after a terrible boating accident, Angela is sent to Camp Arawak where a series of bizarre and violent "accidents" begin to claim the lives of various campers.
movies.title: Sleepaway Camp
movies.tagline: …you won't be coming home!

movies.overview: A razor-wielding serial killer is on the loose, murdering those around Peter Neal, an American mystery author in Italy to promote his newest novel.
movies.title: Tenebre
movies.tagline: Terror Beyond Belief!

movies.overview: When the teenagers in a small Illinois town start getting murdered, the police chief makes a connection to the mysterious scientific experiments being done at the local university and must stop them before his own son is dragged into the deadly scheme.
movies.title: Strange Behavior
movies.tagline: Town population is down... about six feet

movies.overview: A caretaker at a summer camp is burned when a prank goes tragically wrong. After several years of intensive treatment at hospital, he is released back into society, albeit missing some social skills. What follows is a bloody killing spree with the caretaker making his way back to his old stomping ground to confront one of the youths that accidentally burned him.
movies.title: The Burning
movies.tagline: A legend of terror isn't a campfire story anymore!

movies.overview: Alice is a withdrawn 12-year-old who lives with her mother and her younger sister, Karen, who gets most of the attention from her mother, leaving Alice out of the spotlight. When Karen is found brutally murdered in a church, suspicions start to turn toward Alice. But could a 12-year-old girl really be capable of such savagery?
movies.title: Alice, Sweet Alice
movies.tagline: If you survive this night... nothing will scare you again.

movies.overview: In 1970, three children are born at the height of a total eclipse. Due to the sun and moon blocking Saturn, which controls emotions, they have become heartless killers ten years later, and are able to escape detection because of their youthful and innocent facades. A boy and his teenage sister become endangered when they stumble onto the bloody truth.
movies.title: Bloody Birthday
movies.tagline: The nightmare begins with the kids next door.

movies.overview: Thirty years after a murder on the night of Avalon Bay's graduation dance, the sleepy town's teens meet grisly ends at the hands of a prowler once thought to be a jilted soldier home from war.
movies.title: The Prowler
movies.tagline: If you think you're safe... you're DEAD wrong!

movies.overview: After being shot in a toy store, a serial killer transfers his soul into a Good Guy doll. A mother then gifts it to her 6-year old son Andy, which unleashes terror upon the city.
movies.title: Child's Play
movies.tagline: You'll wish it was only make-believe.

movies.overview: Twins Todd and Terry seem like sweet boys -- that is, until one of them takes an axe to the face of a fellow patron at the local drive-in.
movies.title: Nightmare at Shadow Woods
movies.tagline: Not all the evil is on Elm Street ...

movies.overview: Skeptical young detective Ichabod Crane gets transferred to the hamlet of Sleepy Hollow, New York, where he is tasked with investigating the decapitations of three people – murders the townsfolk attribute to a legendary specter, The Headless Horseman.
movies.title: Sleepy Hollow
movies.tagline: Heads will roll.

movies.overview: Caught in a bizarre and terrifying time warp, college student Tree finds herself repeatedly reliving the day of her murder, ultimately realizing that she must identify the killer and the reason for her death before her chances of survival run out.
movies.title: Happy Death Day
movies.tagline: Get up. Live your day. Get killed. Again.

movies.overview: On Halloween, a group of friends encounter an extreme haunted house that promises to feed on their darkest fears. The night turns deadly as they come to the horrifying realisation that some nightmares are real.
movies.title: Haunt
movies.tagline: Some monsters are real.

movies.overview: A quartet of murderous psychopaths break out of a mental hospital during a power blackout and lay siege to their doctor's house.
movies.title: Alone in the Dark
movies.tagline: When the lights go out, the terror begins.

movies.overview: A wealthy New York investment banking executive hides his alternate psychopathic ego from his co-workers and friends as he escalates deeper into his illogical, gratuitous fantasies.
movies.title: American Psycho
movies.tagline: Killer looks.

movies.overview: As the residents of the Pi Kappa Sigma sorority house prepare for the festive season, a stranger begins to harass them with a series of obscene phone calls.
movies.title: Black Christmas
movies.tagline: If this picture doesn't make your skin crawl... it's on TOO TIGHT.

movies.original_title: A Nightmare on Elm Street 3: Dream Warriors
movies.overview: A psychiatrist, familiar with the knife-wielding dream demon Freddy Krueger, helps teens at a mental hospital battle the killer who is invading their dreams.
movies.title: A Nightmare on Elm Street 3: Dream Warriors
movies.tagline: If you think you'll get out alive, you must be dreaming.

movies.overview: Rebellious teen Amy defies her parents by going to a trashy carnival that has pulled into town. In tow are her boyfriend, Buzz, and their friends Liz  and Richie. Thinking it would be fun to spend the night in the campy "Funhouse" horror ride, the teens witness a murder by a deformed worker wearing a mask. Locked in, Amy and her friends must evade the murderous carnival workers and escape before it leaves town the next day.
movies.title: The Funhouse
movies.tagline: Pay to get in. Pray to get out!

movies.overview: Camp counselors are stalked and murdered by an unknown assailant while trying to reopen a summer camp that was the site of a child's drowning.
movies.title: Friday the 13th
movies.tagline: They were warned...They are doomed...And on Friday the 13th, nothing will save them.

movies.overview: An artist slowly goes insane while struggling to pay his bills, work on his paintings, and care for his two female roommates, which leads him taking to the streets of New York after dark and randomly killing derelicts with a power drill.
movies.title: The Driller Killer
movies.tagline: The Blood Runs In Rivers... And The Drill Keeps Tearing Through Flesh And Bone.

movies.overview: When students in the small town of Cherry Falls learn a serial killer is targeting virgins, they realize their only chance of survival is to throw a “Pop Your Cherry” party.
movies.title: Cherry Falls
movies.tagline: Lose your innocence... or lose your life.

movies.overview: An ophthalmologist's assistant with an unhealthy interest in human eyeballs goes on a killing spree to collect eyeballs for his overbearing mother's collection. Reality soon takes a bizarre turn, both for the characters and the audience.
movies.title: Anguish
movies.tagline: The eyes of the city are mine.

movies.overview: Bubba, an intellectually disabled man, is falsely accused of attacking a young girl. Disguised as a scarecrow, he hides in a cornfield, only to be hunted down and shot by four vigilante men. After they are acquitted due to lack of evidence, the men find themselves being stalked one by one.
movies.title: Dark Night of the Scarecrow
movies.tagline: The Original Classic

movies.overview: Undead cop Matt Cordell rises from the grave, and is after the criminals who murdered him in prison.
movies.title: Maniac Cop 2
movies.tagline: You Have The Right To Remain Silent... FOREVER!

movies.overview: Angela Baker escapes from a mental hospital and surfaces at a summer camp as a counselor who lectures her teenage charges on proper moral behavior. Those teens who break her strict rules -- from the camp chatterbox or a sex-obsessed girl to the boys who are peeping Toms -- are murdered by the impostor in various gruesome ways. As more campers go missing, intrepid counselor Molly begins to piece together the truth.
movies.title: Sleepaway Camp II: Unhappy Campers
movies.tagline: She's back...

movies.overview: Norman Bates is declared sane and released from the facility in which he was being held, despite the complaints of Lila Loomis, sister of his most famous victim. Is he really cured, or will he kill again?
movies.title: Psycho II
movies.tagline: It's 22 years later, and Norman Bates is coming home.

movies.original_title: I corpi presentano tracce di violenza carnale
movies.overview: A masked serial killer with psychosexual issues strangles female coeds with scarves before dismembering them. When a wealthy student identifies one of the scarves and thinks she has a lead on a suspect, she becomes the killer's next target, retreating to her family's remote cliffside villa with three of her girlfriends.
movies.title: Torso
movies.tagline: Enter... if you dare the bizarre world of the psychosexual mind.

movies.overview: Ten years after the original Woodsboro murders, one of the survivors returns home to promote their new book about surviving trauma, only for a new Ghostface killer to emerge, targeting a new group of teens.
movies.title: Scream 4
movies.tagline: New decade. New rules.

movies.overview: After losing their baby, a married couple adopt 9-year old Esther, who may not be as innocent as she seems.
movies.title: Orphan
movies.tagline: There's something wrong with Esther.

movies.overview: As soon as Muffy St. John and her college friends arrive on her parents' secluded island, someone starts trimming the guest list... one murder at a time.
movies.title: April Fool's Day
movies.tagline: Guess who's going to be the life of the party?

movies.overview: A maniacal clown named Art terrorizes three young women on Halloween night and everyone else who stands in his way.
movies.title: Terrifier
movies.tagline: You never forget your first kill.

movies.overview: Twenty years after a Valentine's Day tragedy claimed the lives of five miners, Harry Warden returns for a vengeful massacre among teen sweethearts gearing up for another party.
movies.title: My Bloody Valentine
movies.tagline: There's more than one way to lose your heart...

movies.overview: In 1818, when Joseph Mohr is assigned to be the new assistant priest in Oberndorf, a small Austrian town near Salzburg, the young man is full of ideas and ideals. His passion to bring the church closer to the common people sets him on a collision course with his new superior, Father Nostler. When Mohr organizes a church choir that includes outcasts from the local tavern and performs in German instead of Latin, Nostler threatens him with disciplinary action. Their relationship further deteriorates when Maria a regular tavern patron, surprisingly joins the performance of the all-male church choir. As Mohr's initial successes start to crumble and his efforts backfire on him, he loses all hope and faces a trial of faith. The night before Christmas, Mohr has to decide if he will accept defeat and leave Oberndorf or embrace the true significance of the Holy Night.
movies.title: Silent Night
movies.tagline: The powerful true story behind the most popular Christmas carol of all time

movies.overview: As an initiation rite into Alpha Sigma Rho fraternity, four pledges must spend a night in Garth Manor, twelve years to the day after the previous resident murdered his entire family.
movies.title: Hell Night
movies.tagline: Scream and you're dead!

movies.overview: After the death of a high school track star during a race, a mysterious killer in a fencing mask begins murdering her friends and teachers.
movies.title: Graduation Day
movies.tagline: The Class of ‘81 is running out of time!

movies.original_title: A Nightmare on Elm Street 4: The Dream Master
movies.overview: Freddy Krueger returns once again to terrorize the dreams of the remaining Dream Warriors, as well as those of a young woman who may be able to defeat him for good.
movies.title: A Nightmare on Elm Street 4: The Dream Master
movies.tagline: Terror beyond your wildest dreams.

movies.original_title: Hello Mary Lou: Prom Night II
movies.overview: When Hamilton High’s Prom Queen of 1957, Mary Lou Maloney is killed by her jilted boyfriend, she comes back for revenge thirty years later.
movies.title: Hello Mary Lou: Prom Night II
movies.tagline: You Can't Keep a Bad Girl Down!

movies.overview: Two decades after surviving a massacre on October 31, 1978, former baby sitter Laurie Strode finds herself hunted by persistent knife-wielder Michael Myers. Laurie now lives in Northern California under an assumed name, where she works as the headmistress of a private school. But it's not far enough to escape Myers, who soon discovers her whereabouts. As Halloween descends upon Laurie's peaceful community, a feeling of dread weighs upon her -- with good reason.
movies.title: Halloween H20: 20 Years Later
movies.tagline: This summer, terror won't be taking a vacation.

movies.overview: A killer dressed in a police uniform begins murdering innocent people on the streets of New York City.
movies.title: Maniac Cop
movies.tagline: You Have The Right To Remain Silent... Forever.

movies.overview: Winnie's life is less than wonderful one year after saving her town from a psychotic killer on Christmas Eve. When she wishes she was never born, she finds herself magically transported to a nightmarish parallel universe. With the murderous maniac now back, she must team up with a misfit to identify the culprit and get back to her own reality.
movies.title: It's a Wonderful Knife
movies.tagline: This Christmas, your wishes will come true... and your nightmares too.

movies.original_title: Friday the 13th Part VI: Jason Lives
movies.overview: Tommy Jarvis, tormented by the fear that maybe Jason isn't really dead, unwittingly resurrects the mass murderer for another bloody rampage.
movies.title: Friday the 13th Part VI: Jason Lives
movies.tagline: Kill or be killed.

movies.overview: When the senior sorority sisters of Theta Pi decide to do in their demented house mother, someone seeks revenge, and begins a night of terror and madness.
movies.title: The House on Sorority Row
movies.tagline: Sorority sisters... Sisters in life. Sisters in death.

movies.overview: A radio host is victimised by the notorious cannibal family while a former Texas Marshal hunts them.
movies.title: The Texas Chainsaw Massacre 2
movies.tagline: After a decade of silence... the buzzz is back.

movies.overview: After a 4 a.m. knock at the door and haunting voices, Kristen McKay and James Hoyt’s remote getaway becomes a psychological night of terror as three masked strangers invade. Now they must go far beyond what they thought themselves capable of if they hope to survive.
movies.title: The Strangers
movies.tagline: Lock the door. Pretend you're safe.

movies.overview: At a high school senior prom, a masked killer stalks four teenagers who were responsible for the accidental death of a classmate six years prior.
movies.title: Prom Night
movies.tagline: If you're not back by midnight... you won't be coming home!

movies.overview: As the countdown to graduation begins, students at Osborne High are being stalked by a maniac intent on exposing their darkest secrets to the entire town, terrorizing victims while wearing a life-like mask of their own face. With a mysterious past of her own, Makani and her friends must discover the killer's identity before they become victims themselves.
movies.title: There's Someone Inside Your House
movies.tagline: Everyone has a secret to die for.

movies.overview: Bullied by classmates, a pudgy military-school student fights back by computer with the devil.
movies.title: Evilspeak
movies.tagline: Remember the little kid you used to pick on? Well, he's a big boy now.

movies.original_title: I Know What You Did Last Summer
movies.overview: After an accident on a winding road, four teens make the fatal mistake of dumping their victim's body into the sea. Exactly one year later, the deadly secret resurfaces as they're stalked by a hook-handed figure.
movies.title: I Know What You Did Last Summer
movies.tagline: If you're going to bury the truth, make sure it stays buried.

movies.overview: After a man dressed as Santa Claus brutally murders his parents, little Billy Chapman then endures the cruelty of a sadistic nun at his orphanage. Years later, when adult Billy has to fill in for an absent in-store Santa, his childhood trauma brings him to the breaking point.
movies.title: Silent Night, Deadly Night
movies.tagline: He knows when you've been naughty.

movies.overview: Trish invites her high school basketball teammates over for a night they'll never forget when an unexpected guest crashes the party: an escaped psychopath with a portable power drill.
movies.title: The Slumber Party Massacre
movies.tagline: You know the drill.

movies.overview: A TV newswoman catches a pervert watching her sister who cannot see, hear or speak.
movies.title: Eyes of a Stranger
movies.tagline: "Sorry, your party is dead..."

movies.original_title: A Nightmare on Elm Street Part 2: Freddy's Revenge
movies.overview: A teenage boy is haunted in his dreams by deceased child murderer Freddy Krueger, who is out to possess him in order to continue his reign of terror in the real world.
movies.title: A Nightmare on Elm Street Part 2: Freddy's Revenge
movies.tagline: The man of your dreams is back.

movies.overview: As a child, Donald was tormented by his mother who used fire as a punishment. Now a deranged adult, Donald stalks women at clubs, then takes them home where he kills them with a flamethrower.
movies.title: Don't Go in the House
movies.tagline: In a steel room built for revenge they die burning... in chains.

movies.overview: A frustrated Boston detective searches for the maniac responsible for mutilating a number of university coeds.
movies.title: Pieces
movies.tagline: You don't have to go to Texas for a chainsaw massacre!

movies.overview: Best friends Marie and Alexia decide to spend a quiet weekend at Alexia's parents' secluded farmhouse. But on the night of their arrival, the girls' idyllic getaway turns into an endless night of horror.
movies.title: High Tension
movies.tagline: Hearts will bleed.

movies.overview: As bodies begin dropping around the Hollywood set of STAB 3, the third film based on the gruesome Woodsboro killings, Sidney and other survivors are once again terrorized by another Ghostface killer.
movies.title: Scream 3
movies.tagline: The most terrifying scream is always the last.

movies.overview: A family's road trip takes a dangerous turn when they arrive at a secluded mobile home park to stay with some relatives and find it mysteriously deserted. Under the cover of darkness, three masked killers pay them a visit to test the family's every limit as they struggle to survive.
movies.title: The Strangers: Prey at Night
movies.tagline: Let us prey.

movies.overview: Warren Stacy, an office equipment repairman, begins murdering women after they reject his advances. To minimize the evidence, Stacy always kills while naked, wearing nothing but gloves, and further evades the law with his strong alibis. Veteran detective Leo Kessler is convinced of Stacy's guilt and begins using questionable methods to catch him.
movies.title: 10 to Midnight
movies.tagline: A cop... A killer... A deadline...

movies.overview: After their car breaks down, a group of young travelers find themselves stranded at a roadside museum run by the enigmatic Mr. Slausen and populated by his collection of life-like wax mannequins.
movies.title: Tourist Trap
movies.tagline: You'll never be the same again!

movies.overview: A psychotic man, troubled by his childhood abuse, kills and mutilates young women and local models on the streets of New York City.
movies.title: Maniac
movies.tagline: I warned you not to go out tonight!

movies.overview: Four years after the events of Halloween in 2018, Laurie has decided to liberate herself from fear and rage and embrace life. But when a young man is accused of killing a boy he was babysitting, it ignites a cascade of violence and terror that will force Laurie to finally confront the evil she can’t control, once and for all.
movies.title: Halloween Ends
movies.tagline: Only one of them will survive.

movies.original_title: Halloween 4: The Return of Michael Myers
movies.overview: Ten years after his original massacre, the invalid Michael Myers awakens on Halloween Eve and returns to Haddonfield to kill his seven-year-old niece.
movies.title: Halloween 4: The Return of Michael Myers
movies.tagline: Ten years ago he changed the face of Halloween. Tonight, HE'S BACK.

movies.overview: On Halloween night at a horror theme park, a costumed killer begins slaying innocent patrons who believe that it's all part of the festivities.
movies.title: Hell Fest
movies.tagline: Fun going in. Hell getting out.

movies.overview: Michael manages to free himself from Laurie Strode's trap to resume his ritual bloodbath. As she fights for her life from injuries from their last encounter, she inspires her daughter Karen, her granddaughter Allyson, and all of Haddonfield to rise up against the unstoppable monster.
movies.title: Halloween Kills
movies.tagline: Evil dies tonight.

movies.overview: When a former member of a religious cult dies in a mysterious accident, Martha, who now lives alone and close to the cult's church, begins to fear for her life and the lives of her visiting friends.
movies.title: Deadly Blessing
movies.tagline: Pray you're not blesssed.

movies.overview: After picking up a traumatized young hitchhiker, five friends find themselves stalked and hunted by a chainsaw-wielding killer and his family of equally psychopathic killers.
movies.title: The Texas Chainsaw Massacre
movies.tagline: What you know about fear...doesn't even come close.

movies.overview: After failing to kill stubborn survivor Laurie and taking a bullet or six from former psychiatrist Dr. Sam Loomis, Michael Myers has followed Laurie to the Haddonfield Memorial Hospital, where she's been admitted for Myers' attempt on her life. The institution proves to be particularly suited to serial killers, however, as Myers cuts, stabs and slashes his way through hospital staff to reach his favorite victim.
movies.title: Halloween II
movies.tagline: More of the night he came home.

movies.original_title: Friday the 13th Part VII: The New Blood
movies.overview: Tina Shepard, a telekinetic teenage girl, accidentally unchains Jason from his watery grave, allowing him to go on another killing spree in the area.
movies.title: Friday the 13th Part VII: The New Blood
movies.tagline: On Friday the 13th, Jason is back. But this time someone's waiting.

movies.overview: Madman Marz, an old folklore legend who murdered his family before escaping into the woods, is inadvertently summoned to a campsite to finish the spree he started decades ago.
movies.title: Madman
movies.tagline: They thought they were alone.

movies.original_title: A Nightmare on Elm Street: The Dream Child
movies.overview: The pregnant Alice finds Freddy Krueger striking through the sleeping mind of her unborn child, hoping to be reborn into the real world.
movies.title: A Nightmare on Elm Street: The Dream Child
movies.tagline: Freddy delivers.

movies.overview: After nearly 50 years of hiding, Leatherface returns to terrorize a group of idealistic influencers who accidentally disrupt his carefully shielded world in a remote Texas town.
movies.title: Texas Chainsaw Massacre
movies.tagline: The face of madness returns.

movies.overview: In a small town in Wisconsin, a young teenage boy claims he has dreams of young women being brutally raped and murdered. A doctor and the local sheriff discover that the boy's dreams are real and that a sinister cult might be behind the brutal murders. They must track down the vicious killer, who may be the indestructible incarnation of a demon spawned from hell.
movies.title: Incubus
movies.tagline: He is the Destroyer.

movies.overview: Virginia is proud that she belongs to a clique. The best students at a private school. But before her 18th birthday, a gruesome set of murders take place and her friends are the ones who are falling prey. Could it be her? She suffers from blackouts due to a freak accident one year earlier. We soon learn the truth behind her accident and what is going on.
movies.title: Happy Birthday to Me
movies.tagline: Six of the most bizarre murders you will ever see.
